evidence.selected_resource_read_policy: Archive member bytes and manifest data only; no archive extraction, selected executable invocation, compiler/version/import/dlopen/network test, host resource content read, or build-root probe performed.
evidence.elf_member_scope: Every requester/candidate path in the 381 recorded native edges; not a claim that these are all 165 ELF files in the archive.
evidence.per_member_integrity: Each decoded member SHA256 independently checked against the bound manifest.
evidence.elf_decoder: In-memory ELF64 little-endian program-header/PT_DYNAMIC decoding of PT_INTERP, DT_NEEDED, DT_RPATH, DT_RUNPATH, DT_SONAME, plus SHT_GNU_verneed/SHT_GNU_verdef version names.

loader.environment_policy: Construct a fresh environment per process. Do not inherit LD_PRELOAD, LD_AUDIT, LD_DEBUG, LD_ORIGIN_PATH, LD_PROFILE, GLIBC_TUNABLES, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, PYTHONPATH, PYTHONHOME, or any other ambient loader/Python override. --library-path provides the role-specific value; an LD_LIBRARY_PATH alternative must equal that same value and must not be claimed to inhibit the cache.
loader.cache_policy: --inhibit-cache ignores the captured /etc/ld.so.cache. No /etc/ld.so.preload exists in the capture and none may be synthesized.
loader.hwcaps_policy: The empty --glibc-hwcaps-mask disables glibc-hwcaps subdirectory selection. Do not add uncaptured hwcap alternatives.
loader.native_exec_alternative: Native exec with role-specific LD_LIBRARY_PATH has the same selected recorded DT_NEEDED winners because every winner is found before cache/default fallback, but this JSON recommends direct loader invocation to state cache inhibition explicitly.
loader.process_policy: Each role is a fresh exec in the captured-only chroot after UID/GID/group/capability drop. Never load system tools into the Python process or share Python's conda-first library environment with a system role.
loader.proc_policy: Do not mount host /proc. Direct-loader /proc/self/exe can name ld.so rather than the tool; explicit argv0, explicit TeX resource paths and explicit Python paths replace reliance on live self-location.

pdftex.note: The pdflatex program/format selection must also be explicit in compiler arguments; do not infer it solely from canonical pdftex basename.

python_capability_probe.note: Only the separately frozen tiny capability code, not an open-ended import/dlopen/discovery test.

algorithm.needed: For each role-profile requester, expand $ORIGIN/${ORIGIN} from its absolute captured path. Search requester's DT_RPATH only when DT_RUNPATH is absent, then the exact role library path, then requester's DT_RUNPATH. Resolve each candidate exclusively through manifest symlink bytes. The first captured regular ELF target is selected and must appear in the audited edge candidate set.
algorithm.rpath_inheritance_disposition: Python main and applicable ancestor RPATH values all normalize to /root/miniconda3/lib, already the first role library directory; inherited RPATH therefore cannot change these selected winners. System closure objects have no RPATH/RUNPATH.
algorithm.loaded_object_disposition: All occurrences of a DT_NEEDED name select the same canonical target inside a role profile; already-loaded SONAME reuse cannot introduce an alternative winner in these graphs.
algorithm.interpreter: PT_INTERP is resolved through manifest symlink bytes and bound to the one captured loader. PT_INTERP rows on a library describe ELF metadata, not a claim that this library is executed as a separate program.
algorithm.version_check: Every recorded version requirement name from a requester's SHT_GNU_verneed is contained in the selected target's SHT_GNU_verdef names. There are zero mismatches. This does not prove symbol-by-symbol relocation, ABI behavior, import success or unrecorded dlopen closure.
algorithm.no_default_dependency: Every selected DT_NEEDED edge has a winner in its listed explicit search directories. Cache and compiled default directories are not needed to establish this static graph.
algorithm.failure_rule: A missing selected target, changed hash/link, new unexpected native load, symbol failure or import failure is a real profile failure. Do not consult live-host resources or silently widen directories/roots.

ambiguity_disposition.note: The 9 unreachable ambiguous edges are excluded, not assigned a fictitious runtime winner.

python_import_policy.absent_optional_zip: /root/miniconda3/lib/python312.zip is not captured; omit it from the validator's explicit sys.path instead of declaring it a present resource.
python_import_policy.site_policy: -S prevents .pth/site customization. Explicit captured site-packages path admits pymupdf; fitz shim is not needed. No user site, cwd or ambient PYTHONPATH.
python_import_policy.supported_native_superset: Captured lib-dynload extensions except the ten explicitly excluded paths, plus all four native pymupdf members. The superset establishes available native selections; it does not claim every listed extension is imported or authorize its unrelated network/database/audio/testing functionality. Only the frozen validator imports are permitted; incidental test-helper extensions present in this static superset are not invoked.

materialization_constraints: All captured absolute paths are interpreted inside the chroot. Resolve /lib -> usr/lib and /lib64 -> usr/lib64 only within that namespace.

Ancestor directories /root, /root/miniconda3, /root/miniconda3/lib and /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu have no own capture rows; synthesize structural ancestors with separately declared traversable read-only mode, not host metadata or content.
Raw absolute symlinks must never be followed by generic host extraction; validate each target resolution inside the destination root.

Use a controller-declared read-only resource transform, with writable outputs/cache/tmp kept separate. Original captured modes remain source-evidence fields, not automatically runtime directory modes.
No host /proc, host root bind, live font/TeX/Python paths, socket/device inheritance, ambient config or external executable fallback.
Omitted initex/map/language generation resources remain forbidden; use the captured format/map under the separate TeX profile.

libnss3 dependencies are statically captured, but PDF signature validation/security database initialization is not requested or established. No runtime capture is authorized if an unrequested NSS provider path appears.
